ideas.pitch: An AI-powered local industrial and campus waste audit system that uses satellite/drone imagery and computer vision to flag environmental compliance breaches.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation Hackathon: addressing real-world challenges through open domains such as environmental sustainability and industrial monitoring.
ideas.title: EcoAudit-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite/aerial monitoring to environmental compliance, capturing immediate interest from judges looking for tangible societal impact.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven patient trust and intake engine specifically tailored for local student health centers and charitable clinics to boost patient acquisition.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation Hackathon: healthcare access and institutional trust enhancement under the open innovation format.
ideas.title: MediTrust-Acquire
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the rapid deployment template from Global-Smile, demonstrating immediate operational utility for local healthcare providers within a tight timeline.

ideas.pitch: A graph-intelligence platform designed to audit university club finances and spot anomalies in event sponsorship funds using explainable machine learning.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation Hackathon: open innovation prototype solving organizational transparency and financial security.
ideas.title: CampusGraph AML Risk Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the heavy financial engineering and graph intelligence patterns seen in the Bito platform to a domain instantly relatable to college organizers.

ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision workout and sports posture analyzer designed for university athletes to prevent injury using pose estimation.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation Hackathon: fitness, health, and student well-being under the open innovation themes.
ideas.title: CampusBiomechanics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the proven winner formula of CricketVision_AI by implementing MediaPipe pose estimation for an instantly demoable, highly visual presentation.

ideas.pitch: A localized multi-agent support platform utilizing RAG to help students navigate campus sustainability guidelines, academic queries, and administrative procedures.
ideas.problem_statement: Open Innovation Hackathon: educational efficiency and green campus initiatives under the open innovation framework.
ideas.title: GreenCampus Multi-Agent Support
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the multi-agent RAG workflow proven by greennovation-ai-platform, offering a robust and fully working AI application in a short time.
